Request for Proposal — Security Services
Powai Campus · Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd

1. Scope of Requirements
Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd invites proposals from qualified private security agencies for round-the-clock physical security coverage across its Powai Campus facility. The requirements listed below define the mandatory and operational expectations.

Code Requirement Mandatory Acceptance Criteria
REQ-01 Trained guards 24×7 at all three campus gates (mandatory). Yes Duty roster confirms 24×7 guard deployment at Gates 1, 2, and 3.
REQ-02 Valid private security agency licence for Maharashtra (mandatory). Yes Active PSARA licence copy for Maharashtra submitted.
REQ-03 One security supervisor on site every shift (mandatory). Yes Designated supervisor deployed on site for every active shift.
REQ-04 Visitor log at reception for every entry and exit (mandatory). Yes Visitor register or digital log maintained at reception for all visits.
REQ-05 Fire-safety training within 30 days of deployment. No Guards complete certified fire-safety training within 30 days.
REQ-06 Monthly incident report to the facilities manager. No Comprehensive incident report submitted monthly.

Fictional demo document

secureshield.text: SecureShield Guards — Technical & Commercial Proposal Security Services for Powai Campus · Submitted to Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd 1. Operational Deployment & Scope SecureShield Guards commits to deploying trained guards 24×7 at all three campus gates. Continuous vigilance and physical security will be maintained across all campus entry and exit points. Our agency holds a valid private security agency licence for Maharashtra under registration number PSARA-MH-2023-F9876, valid to 2028. One dedicated security supervisor is stationed on site every shift to oversee guard operations and handle immediate escalations. A formal visitor register at reception is strictly maintained for every entry and exit. All deployed personnel undergo certified fire-safety training within 30 days of initial deployment. A detailed monthly incident report will be submitted directly to the facilities manager at the close of every month. 2. Commercial Terms Commercial Item Monthly Fee (INR) Monthly base security fee (all 3 gates 24×7, supervisor every shift) ■3,20,000 GST @ 18% ■57,600 Total Monthly Billing ■3,77,600 The monthly rate of ■3,20,000 + GST includes all guard deployments, on-site supervision every shift, visitor register management, fire-safety training within 30 days, and monthly incident reporting. apex.text:
Apex Patrol Services — Proposal for Security Services
Powai Campus · Prepared for Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd
## 1. Guard Coverage and Operations
Apex Patrol Services proposes guard coverage with Gates 1–2 manned 24×7, while Gate 3 will have day shift only coverage.
Regarding statutory compliance, our private security agency licence renewal applied for with the controlling authority.
On-site supervisory coverage includes day supervision; supervisor night shift on request.
A visitor log maintained at reception for tracking building entries and exits.
Specialised guard fire-safety training is available on request, at additional cost.
Operations will provide a quarterly incident report to client management.
## 2. Commercial Quotation
Item Description | Price (INR)
Base security services fee | ₹2,65,000/month + GST
Overtime | at actuals
Fire-safety training | on request, at additional cost
The monthly base contract fee is ₹2,65,000/month + GST. Any guard overtime beyond scheduled shift hours will be billed at actuals. Night shift supervision and fire-safety training are provided on request at additional cost.

Request for Proposal — Pantry & Cafeteria Services
BKC Office · Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd

1. Requirements Specifications
Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd requires a qualified catering and cafeteria partner to operate the corporate pantry and cafeteria at its BKC Office location. All catering operations must fulfill the requirements below.

Code Requirement Mandatory Acceptance Criteria
REQ-01 Valid FSSAI licence (mandatory). Yes Active FSSAI food business operating licence provided.
REQ-02 Breakfast and lunch Monday to Friday for up to 150 staff (mandatory). Yes Daily breakfast and lunch service Mon–Fri covering up to 150 personnel.
REQ-03 Daily kitchen hygiene checklist signed by the supervisor (mandatory). Yes Checklist executed daily and signed by the catering supervisor.
REQ-04 Weekly menu shared every Friday. No Planned menu circulated to facilities management every Friday.
REQ-05 Tea and coffee stations refilled twice daily. No Beverage stations replenished at least twice per day.

freshbite.text:
FreshBite Caterers — Pantry & Cafeteria Proposal
BKC Office Catering · Submitted to Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd
## 1. Operational Capabilities and Scope
FreshBite Caterers holds an active food safety licence with FSSAI licence number stated: FSSAI-MH-2023-009876543210.
We provide full breakfast + lunch Mon–Fri up to 150 staff at the corporate cafeteria. All meals are prepared fresh adhering to high quality and nutritional standards.
Our kitchen team maintains a strict daily hygiene checklist signed by supervisor to ensure sanitation.
A rotational weekly menu every Friday is circulated in advance to the facilities team.
Corporate tea/coffee refilled twice daily across all designated pantry beverage points.
## 2. Commercial Quotation
Service Component | Monthly Pricing (INR)
Base cafeteria service fee (breakfast & lunch up to 150 staff) | ₹2,10,000
GST @ 18% | ₹37,800
Total Monthly Fee | ₹2,47,800
Commercial fee is ₹2,10,000/month + GST. All culinary raw materials included in the monthly fee. No additional charges apply.

Gourmet Pantry Co — Corporate Catering Proposal
Cafeteria & Pantry Services for BKC Office · Northbridge Properties Pvt Ltd

1. Service Specifications
Gourmet Pantry Co notes that statutory FSSAI registration in process under reference FSSAI-ACK-2026-00412.
